comment: Pinned upstream sources for the FULL Windows release bundle (tools/fetch_engines.py).
INTEGRITY IS FAIL-CLOSED: 'sha256' MUST be a 64-hex digest. fetch_engines.py refuses to
bundle any engine whose sha256 is empty or does not match the download, so an unverified
third-party binary is never shipped in a forensic tool. To populate the digests the first
time (or after bumping a version/url), run on a networked machine:
and commit the printed values here. A release maintainer MUST also confirm each 'url' and
'version' points at the intended official artifact before the first release.
Layout targets match CaseKey's portable discovery (see DependencyProbe::resolveTool):
hashcat -> tools/hashcat/, john (+*2john) -> tools/john/run/, bkcrack -> tools/bkcrack/,

engines.notes: Embeddable interpreter so the John *2john Python scripts (e.g. office2john) run with no separate install; CaseKey.cmd puts it on PATH.
